//: Orthanc is the DICOM server: QIDO-RS / WADO-RS / STOW-RS plus indexing.
ADR-3 chose it precisely so none of that is hand-rolled.
NETWORK POSITION: private subnet, reachable ONLY from the API. The browser
never talks to Orthanc directly (P8.2) — every DICOMweb request is proxied
so that authorization is applied and a StudyAccessed audit row is written.
A direct browser path would bypass both, and the audit log would then be
missing exactly the accesses that matter.
ORTHANC IS AN INDEX, NOT THE SOURCE OF RECORD. The source of record is the
object in the originals bucket (ADR-4). If Orthanc's database is lost it is
rebuilt by re-STOWing the originals; if the originals are lost, nothing
rebuilds them. Every setting below follows from that asymmetry.
Name: MIR
//StorageDirectory: Unused when the object-storage plugin is active — DICOM files live in S3
under a dedicated prefix. This path holds only the SQLite/Postgres index
when a local index is configured.
//Http: Bound to localhost inside the pod/task; the API reaches it over the private network only.
//DicomProtocol: The DIMSE (port 104/4242) protocol is DISABLED. v1 ingests exclusively via
STOW-RS from the API. Leaving a DICOM listener open would be a second,
unauthenticated ingestion path into the source of record — one that
bypasses the P7.4 validation pipeline entirely.
//Authentication: Credentials are injected from AWS Secrets Manager at deploy time and are
never committed (BUILD_SPEC §6). RemoteAccessAllowed is required because
the API is a different host; the network boundary — security group, private
subnet — is what actually restricts who can reach this port.
//SslNote: TLS terminates at the internal load balancer; Orthanc is not internet-facing.
//Plugins: DICOMweb for QIDO/WADO/STOW; object-storage to keep pixel data in S3.

DicomWeb.//StowMaxInstances: 0 = unlimited; a 120-slice CT arrives as many instances.

//Overwrite: OverwriteInstances is FALSE: an instance already stored is never replaced.
Re-STOWing the same SOP Instance UID during a job retry must be a no-op,
not a rewrite — the originals bucket is immutable and Orthanc must not
//Lossy: ADR-5: never transcode to a lossy transfer syntax.
IngestTranscoding is deliberately ABSENT rather than set to "". Orthanc
parses an empty string as a transfer syntax name and refuses to start:
Parameter out of range: Unknown transfer syntax for ingest transcoding:
Omitting the key is how 'do not transcode' is expressed. Do not add it
back with any value — every value is a re-encode.
//Jobs: Long-running jobs survive restart so a large STOW batch is not lost.
//Logging: Verbose logging is OFF in production: Orthanc logs include patient
identifiers from DICOM headers, and P13 requires that patient identifiers
do not reach the log store.
//UnknownSopClassAccepted: Reject anything the pipeline has not validated.
//StableAge: Seconds of inactivity before a study is considered stable.
